name: Starship | Integrated Flight Test 6
description: Sixth test flight of the two-stage Starship launch vehicle.

landing.description: The Superheavy booster No. 13 did not attempt a return back to the launch site at Starbase and splashed down in the Gulf of Mexico instead, due to hardware problems on the launch and catch tower triggering an abort.
